rows.en: Destron's Great Leader! Where is Kazami?
I have no further use for that man! He was nothing but bait to lure you here.
What!? Then…
Exactly! You fell right into my trap, didn't you? Kamen Riders!!
Whoa!?
Kuh… what is this?

This light is the Cyborg Disintegration Ray developed by Destron's scientists!

No one will ever lay eyes on you again!
Uuugh…
Damn…
Fufufu… In 10 more seconds your entire bodies will disintegrate! Farewell, Kamen Riders!!
Senpai!!
Stay back, Kazami!
Stay back!!
Kazami, hang in there! Kazamiii!!
At this rate, he'll die!
Kazami… was ready to die to save us! I don't want to let him die.
…Then there's only one way!
Right!
Mm…
Right…
Full energy!!
Full energy!!
What's going on here!?
What!?
Uoooh!!
Zookaaa!! After shooting that much… Kamen Rider's got to be dead for sure, right?
Hahahaha…
Until Destron is defeated, Kamen Rider will never die!
Damn iiit!! They're alive! Get them!
So these guys are the new organization, Destron?
Hongo, Ichimonji! Everyone has come too.
So these guys… are the new organization, Destron?
Hongo, Ichimonji! Everyone came too!

Wait!

I am Shiro Kazami, whose family you murdered!

Inheriting the power of the Double Riders, I've been reborn as Kamen Rider 3, to defeat Destron!
Oh! It worked!
Oh! It worked!
Yeah… we did it!
Yeah… we did it!
Rider 3!? Who do you think you are?
Kamen Rider V3!!
Nngh… insolent! Take the attack of our Destron!

I still don't… know my true power as V3!

How well… can I really fight against Scissors Jaguar?
Scissoooors!! Rider V3 is bewildered by his own abilities! V3 is nothing to fear! Here I come!

Dad, Mom, Yukiko… please rest in peace.

Against my will, I, Shiro, have lost the body my parents gave me.

But please forgive me, as I put it to use for justice and peace… for the sake of many people.

To destroy Destron… and every evil there is, I will fight! Please watch over me from the distant sky…
Kazami…
Senpai…
We're leaving Japan…
What do you mean… Senpai?
We've got a fine successor now.
I'm going to Australia… after Destron's overseas branch.
I'm off to America.
Until the day the three Kamen Riders can fight side by side, everything depends on your strength!
We're counting on you to protect Japan! Go for it, Kamen Rider V3!
We'll be watching over you!
And so Shiro Kazami was reborn as Rider 3, the warrior of justice Kamen Rider V3.
But before him awaited mighty foes, starting with Destron, reorganized by the Great Leader who had once led Shocker and Gel-Shocker.
With Kamen Rider V3, heir to Rider 1's technique and Rider 2's power, now among their comrades, the heroes sensed that the end of the fight to restore peace was still a long way off…
The news "General Black has appeared!" was quickly brought to Takeshi Hongo and the other heroes at Snack Amigo…

Kuh… I got careless!?

But this is nothing compared to what our Destron can really do! Better be ready! Hahaha…
Nngh… You'll pay for this! Damn Kamen Riders!!
Defeat the executive monster Ganikomol and all Gel-Shocker Combatants!
Defeat the Shocker Riders and all Gel-Shocker Combatants!
Defeat Hiru-Chameleon and all Gel-Shocker Combatants!
Defeat Scissors Jaguar and all Destron Combatants!
Defeat Kamebazooka and all Destron Combatants!
Defeat all Destron Monsters and Destron Combatants!
Shiro Kazami is defeated

Still haven't got the blueprints? Kaimen Green!!

If Kikaider gets his hands on those blueprints, he'll become a perfect, invincible android!

If that happens… this ultrasonic flute will be useless!

DARK will have no chance of winning… DARK will be driven to ruin.

Rest assured… Professor Gill!

We're keeping watch on Mitsuko, who knows where the Conscience Circuit blueprints are. Please wait just a little longer.

Very well, I'll wait one more day!

But if you fail… Kaimen Green! Consider your life forfeit!!

Hmph… If you'd done as I said from the start, it wouldn't have come to this!

It's because you play these useless little tricks that Kikaider and his lot get the better of you.
Silence, Hakaider!
Fufufufu… Professor Gill.
Who's there…?

A pleasure to make your acquaintance…

I am… a top executive of the great global crime organization "Shadow", the Knight of Shadows, Shadow Knight!

Shadow Knight?

And… what business could this Shadow organization of yours have with me?
Our Shadow wishes to lend you its wisdom, to dispose of that hateful Kikaider and his kind…
What? You mean to cooperate with our DARK? And what brilliant plan have you got?

uncertain: U04423/U04460/U04462: 先輩 kept as 'Senpai' (Kazami is Hongo's junior from university; the relationship carries meaning).
U04447: speaker 'New-Model Kamen Rider' (glossary) is V3 before naming himself.
U04475/U04478/U04479: garbled 幹頼恩荒 / 劣愛員 / 葉て read as 幹部怪人 / 戦闘員 / 全て.
U04492: どんな名事 read as どんな名案 (what brilliant plan), consistent with B0062 U04948 and the reply in U04493.
